name: VectorCraft
description: Create and edit vector artwork, artboards and typography headlessly; deliver native documents and SVG, PDF or PNG artifacts.
progressive_guidance: The CLI downloads automatically from the pinned release archives. Operations run headlessly without opening a window or requiring a generation-provider account. Discover command IDs and params before editing. Ordinary edits stage a source copy and publish new files. Engine commands with explicit paths can still access the local filesystem; use file, script, preference or destructive operations only when explicitly requested. Preserve originals and inspect diagnostics. A successful command is not proof of visual quality: inspect a rendered preview before delivering artwork or video.

commands.description: Discover vector commands, labels and accepted parameters, optionally filtered by text.

filter.description: Text to search in the installed command registry.

inspect.description: Read bounded document artboards, objects and fonts; options support IDs, kind and pagination. Results report total and childCount when sliced.

kind.description: Observed object kind; returns matching nodes.

edit.description: Create a vector document or edit a source copy using discovered engine commands; attach native, SVG and PNG artifacts.

command.description: An engine command ID observed through commands.

params.description: Parameters discovered from the installed command registry.

inputPath.description: Absolute existing project/document. Omit to start a new empty project.

edit.progressive_guidance: Start new documents with the observed file.new params. Returned SVG and PNG cover the first artboard; the .vectorcraft artifact retains all artboards. Discover shape, path, style and text operations with commands. Use export for a multi-page PDF.

export.description: Export a local vector document as SVG, PDF or PNG. PNG is also attached as model evidence when bounded.

format.description: Defaults to svg. PDF includes all artboards; SVG/PNG use the first.

findObjects.description: Find document objects by observed name, text, kind, geometry or anchor-count filters without saving or changing selection. Returns bounded matches and the total count.
findObjects.progressive_guidance: Discover document.find parameters with commands. Supply at least one filter; all supplied filters must match. Use returned IDs with inspect options.ids to read the matching objects.

filters.description: Observed document.find filters, e.g. name, text, kind, within or minAnchors. Selection is never changed.
